title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
release_date: 2025-09-04 (PC Steam, Switch, Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, day-one on Xbox/PC Game Pass)
team_size: ~3 core developers (co-directors/artists Ari Gibson and William Pellen + programmer Jack Vine) plus composer Christopher Larkin, a marketing/publishing lead (Matthew Griffin) and a few contractors for testing, extra programming and ports [CONFIRMED in substance – team members named in interviews, summarised by GosuGamers/Halftone; exact headcount incl. contractors not disclosed]
developer_background: Second commercial game. Team Cherry's first game Hollow Knight (2017, Kickstarter-funded ~AUD 57k) sold 15M+ copies by Aug 2025 [CONFIRMED – reported in press]. Silksong began as a Hornet DLC (Kickstarter stretch goal) and grew into a full sequel, announced 2019-02-14.
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1030300/Hollow_Knight_Silksong/ ; also Nintendo Switch / Switch 2 eShop, PlayStation Store (PS4/PS5), Microsoft Store/Xbox (incl. Game Pass Ultimate & PC Game Pass day one)
business_model: premium $19.99 (no launch discount; first discount -20% to $15.99 on 2025-12-18 per SteamDB); OST DLC $11.99; free 'Sea of Sorrow' expansion announced for 2026; Game Pass deal (terms undisclosed)
units_or_downloads: 7,000,000+ paid copies across all platforms in ~3 months, excluding Game Pass ("millions more" played via Game Pass) [CONFIRMED – Team Cherry announcement 2025-12-16, via PC Gamer/VGChartz]. Earlier: ~4.2M sales after ~2 weeks (3.2M+ Steam, ~500k PS, ~500k Switch) + ~1.5M Game Pass downloads [ESTIMATE – GameDiscoverCo, Sept 2025]; 6M+ all platforms incl. 4M Steam after 4 weeks [ESTIMATE – Alinea Analytics, Oct 2025]. Steam-only lifetime trackers: Gamalytic 5.6M (range 3.3–7.8M), PlayTracker 5.84M, VG Insights 6.65M [ESTIMATE – trackers collated by SteamDB, snapshot dates late 2025/2026]. No 2026 official update found.
peak_concurrent_players: 587,150 on Steam, 2025-09-06 (launch day 534,450–535,213; 2nd-highest indie peak ever, ~17th-18th all-time on Steam) [CONFIRMED – SteamDB / Steam data via GameSpot, TheGamer]. Lead of ~587k verified.
steam_reviews: ~380,300 total reviews all languages, 'Very Positive' (English ~143–146k, 93% positive) [Steam store page snapshot, undated 2026]; Gamalytic lists 424.5K reviews, 90% score (date uncertain, likely mid/late 2026); 277,451 at 85% positive (~2025-11-06, GamesRadar). Chinese-language reviews dropped to 'Mostly Negative' at launch over a poor translation (since patched).
implied_review_multiplier: ~21–25 all-platform units per Steam review (7M confirmed units ÷ est. ~280–330k Steam reviews in Nov–Dec 2025) [ESTIMATE]; Steam-only ≈ 15–20 (4.5–5.6M Steam units ÷ ~300k reviews). Very low ratio = extremely engaged fanbase with high review propensity; a default 40× Boxleiter would overestimate Silksong's sales by ~2×.
gross_revenue: ≈ $105M all platforms by Dec 2025 [ESTIMATE – 7M confirmed units × $15 avg realised price ($19.99 × 0.75)]. Steam-only: Gamalytic $86M gross base game (range $51–121M) [ESTIMATE – Gamalytic]; ~$67.5M [ESTIMATE – 4.5M Steam units × $15]. Excludes undisclosed Game Pass payment and OST sales.
net_revenue: ≈ $72M to Team Cherry [ESTIMATE – Steam portion $67.5M gross: tiered cut (30% first $10M, 25% $10–50M, 20% above) = $51.0M × 0.93 = $47.4M; console portion ~$37.5M × 0.70 × 0.93 = $24.4M]. Self-published, so no publisher split. Plus undisclosed Microsoft Game Pass deal.
production_cost: ≈ $2–3M [ESTIMATE – ~4–5 people (core + composer/contractors) × ~78 months × $6k/month ≈ $1.9–2.3M, plus porting/QA/localisation contractors]. No disclosed figure. Funded from Hollow Knight profits.
development_time: ~6.5–7 years [CONFIRMED in substance – started as Hornet DLC ~2018, announced as full sequel 2019-02-14, released 2025-09-04; Team Cherry said 'it was never stuck… we're a small team, and games take a lot of time'].
why_popular: Sequel to a 15M-selling cult classic after a 6.5-year wait that became a meme ('Silksong when?', clown-nose ritual at every showcase); #1 most-wishlisted game on Steam (~4.8M wishlists per Alinea). Hand-drawn art, Christopher Larkin's score, tight combat and a huge, dense world at a $19.99 price that undercut $70 AAA games. High difficulty generated discourse/virality ('Best Game You Suck At' Steam Award; also won Steam Awards 2025 Game of the Year). Metacritic ~90.
marketing_channels: Almost zero paid marketing; built on years of organic community hype and memes (Reddit r/Silksong, Discord, YouTube/Twitch 'Silksong news' meme culture). Reveal in Nintendo Switch 2 Direct (2025-04-02) confirmed 2025; release date revealed in a short Team Cherry trailer ~2 weeks before launch (2025-08-21). Day-one Game Pass, simultaneous launch on every major platform, aggressive $19.99 price. Huge streamer coverage at launch.
engine: Unity (Unity 6 for launch) [CONFIRMED – Unity 'Made with Unity' Hollow Knight showcase page referencing Silksong; original HK used Unity + 2D Toolkit + PlayMaker visual scripting]
art_style: Hand-drawn 2D art with painterly backgrounds and layered parallax, frame-by-frame-style animation, gothic insect-kingdom aesthetic, orchestral/chamber soundtrack
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write most platformer/Metroidvania code (state machines, hitboxes, save system, map system, boss AI patterns), generate concept art, background paintings and SFX, draft lore/item text, and produce placeholder music. | AI cannot: match Team Cherry-level hand-drawn animation consistency (AI sprite animation is still weak for fluid frame-by-frame combat), tune precise game feel (input buffering, hit-stop, i-frames), design an interconnected world map, boss pattern balance and difficulty curve, or replicate a 15M-player fanbase. A full Silksong-scale game (~40+ hours, 200+ enemies/bosses) is not solo-feasible; a 3–5 hour Metroidvania 'in spirit' is. | Toolset: Claude Code + Godot 4 (or Unity 6) + GodotSteam; Retro Diffusion / Scenario / Midjourney for backgrounds and sprite bases, PixelLab or manual cleanup for animation (or simpler pixel-art style to reduce animation cost), ElevenLabs SFX, Suno/Udio for temp music then a freelance composer.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 2–3 months, $300–$1,000 (one biome, movement + combat + 1–2 bosses + map; Claude Pro/Max, image gen, audio subs, Steam Direct $100)
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 12–18 months, $5,000–$20,000 (3–5 hour Metroidvania with 4–6 biomes, 8–12 bosses; includes freelance animator/sprite cleanup $2–8k, composer $1.5–5k, localisation, playtest/marketing budget; excludes developer's own living costs)

data_conflicts: Peak CCU: early reports say 535k (launch day, 2025-09-04); the all-time peak is 587,150 on 2025-09-06 (SteamDB) – used 587,150. Steam unit estimates vary widely: Alinea 4M (Oct 2025), GameDiscoverCo 3.2M+ (Sept 2025), Gamalytic 5.6M, PlayTracker 5.84M, VG Insights 6.65M (later snapshots) – Team Cherry's 7M+ is all-platform and is the only confirmed number; Steam share assumed ~4.5M of 7M (~65%) for net revenue. Review counts differ by snapshot (277k Nov 2025 → ~380k → Gamalytic 424.5K); dates of the latter two are not certain. Dev time quoted as '6 years' (Wccftech) vs '7 years' (most press) depending on start date – used ~6.5–7 years. No official 2026 sales update found; Sea of Sorrow DLC still dated only '2026'.
notes: Key lesson for solo creators: Silksong's success is not replicable from zero; it rests on a 15M-copy predecessor and years of meme-driven anticipation. But the pricing lesson is transferable: a premium indie at $19.99 launching against $70 AAA got huge goodwill. Its unusually low review multiplier (~15–25) shows that hardcore single-player sequels with passionate fans review far more often than average; use 30 or lower for such games. Self-publishing on every platform simultaneously plus a Game Pass deal maximised reach. Chinese localisation quality mattered: a bad translation caused 14k+ negative reviews in days.
